apps.purpose: Help aquarium volunteers follow the evolutionary story from cosmic and planetary context through LUCA, mitochondria, chloroplasts, algae, plants, kelp, animals, and humans.

apps.notes: Hub launches the maintained standalone GitHub Pages PWA so the Evolution Timeline can continue independent development. The app includes a direct Return to MBA Hub control.
